detail.longDescription: Five `hermes update` timeouts in a row: a merge-base check exceeding its own 10-second budget. Day-one fix: repacking 43 git packs into 2. Lasting fix: reading the updater's source — it disables commit-graphs in partial clones by design, and its cleanup can't see packs from a 2025-era full clone. The real answer was migration: the official installer swapped a 2.9 GB legacy checkout for a 993 MB blobless one. The check now passes in 0.002 s. https:// docs.agenteum.top/blog/2026-10 -21-hermes-update-timeouts-legacy-source-install # hermes # linux # selfhosted
